entries.title: Psalms 139:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> O Jehovah, thou hast searched me, and known [me].

entries.title: Psalms 139:2
segments: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising; Thou understandest my thought afar off.

entries.title: Psalms 139:3
segments: Thou searchest out my path and my lying down, And art acquainted with all my ways.

entries.title: Psalms 139:4
segments: For there is not a word in my tongue, But, lo, O Jehovah, thou knowest it altogether.

entries.title: Psalms 139:5
segments: Thou hast beset me behind and before, And laid thy hand upon me.

entries.title: Psalms 139:6
segments: [Such] knowledge is too wonderful for me; It is high, I cannot attain unto it.

entries.title: Psalms 139:7
segments: Whither shall I go from thy Spirit? Or whither shall I flee from thy presence?

entries.title: Psalms 139:8
segments: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, thou art there.

entries.title: Psalms 139:9
segments: If I take the wings of the morning, And dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;

entries.title: Psalms 139:10
segments: Even there shall thy hand lead me, And thy right hand shall hold me.

entries.title: Psalms 139:11
segments: If I say, Surely the darkness shall overwhelm me, And the light about me shall be night;

entries.title: Psalms 139:12
segments: Even the darkness hideth not from thee, But the night shineth as the day: The darkness and the light are both alike [to thee].

entries.title: Psalms 139:13
segments: For thou didst form my inward parts: Thou didst cover me in my mother's womb.

entries.title: Psalms 139:14
segments: I will give thanks unto thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: Wonderful are thy works; And that my soul knoweth right well.

entries.title: Psalms 139:15
segments: My frame was not hidden from thee, When I was made in secret, [And] curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 139:16
segments: Thine eyes did see mine unformed substance; And in thy book they were all written, [Even] the days that were ordained [for me], When as yet there was none of them.

entries.title: Psalms 139:17
segments: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! How great is the sum of them!

entries.title: Psalms 139:18
segments: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: When I awake, I am still with thee.

entries.title: Psalms 139:19
segments: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: Depart from me therefore, ye bloodthirsty men.

entries.title: Psalms 139:20
segments: For they speak against thee wickedly, And thine enemies take [thy name] in vain.

entries.title: Psalms 139:21
segments: Do not I hate them, O Jehovah, that hate thee? And am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?

entries.title: Psalms 139:22
segments: I hate them with perfect hatred: They are become mine enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 139:23
segments: Search me, O God, and know my heart: Try me, and know my thoughts;

entries.title: Psalms 139:24
segments: And see if there be any wicked way in me, And lead me in the way everlasting.
